lines.en: I guess I'm just really sad that I'm leaving.
I'm gonna miss you so much.
Well, this doesn't have to be so sad, though, you know?
Maybe instead of just thinking about how much you're gonna miss each other,
you should, like, think about some of the things that you're not gonna miss.
Come on, there's gotta be something.
Great, okay, you can go first.
Uh, well, I guess I'm not gonna miss the fact
that you're never allowed to move the phone pen.
You know, does Rachel move the phone pen?
Okay, good. There you go. Doesn't everyone feel better?
It's not just the phone pen.
Yeah, well, I don't think it really counts
if you have to read 'em off the back of your hand
after you fall asleep on the couch.
So, so you missed a message from who?
